adv.am.root.title: Naruto Anime Mod
adv.am.root.desc: Aprenda a fazer selos: tecle C, V e B na ordem certa.
adv.am.substitution_jutsu.title: Kawarimi no Jutsu
adv.am.substitution_jutsu.desc: Rank E - combo: C. Troca de lugar com um tronco. Esquiva automatica.
adv.am.transformation_jutsu.title: Henge no Jutsu
adv.am.transformation_jutsu.desc: Rank E - combo: V. Copia a aparencia de um mob ou jogador.
adv.am.body_flicker_technique.title: Shunshin no Jutsu
adv.am.body_flicker_technique.desc: Rank D - combo: B. Dash instantaneo na direcao da mira.
adv.am.kage_bunshin_no_jutsu.title: Kage Bunshin no Jutsu
adv.am.kage_bunshin_no_jutsu.desc: Rank B - combo: C-V. Cria um clone de sombra que luta por voce.
adv.am.multiple_shadow_clones.title: Taju Kage Bunshin
adv.am.multiple_shadow_clones.desc: Rank A - combo: C-B. Varios clones de sombra de uma vez.
adv.am.great_fireball_jutsu.title: Katon: Goukakyuu
adv.am.great_fireball_jutsu.desc: Rank C - combo: V-C. Bola de fogo em linha reta.
adv.am.phoenix_flower_jutsu.title: Katon: Housenka
adv.am.phoenix_flower_jutsu.desc: Rank C - combo: V-V. Rajada de bolas de fogo em leque.
adv.am.amaterasu.title: Amaterasu
adv.am.amaterasu.desc: Rank S - combo: V-B. Chama negra que nao se apaga.
adv.am.water_bullet_jutsu.title: Suiton: Suidan
adv.am.water_bullet_jutsu.desc: Rank C - combo: B-C. Projetil de agua.
adv.am.water_prison_jutsu.title: Suiton: Suirou
adv.am.water_prison_jutsu.desc: Rank B - combo: B-V. Prisao de agua no alvo.
adv.am.exploding_water_wave.title: Suiton: Bakusui Shouha
adv.am.exploding_water_wave.desc: Rank A - combo: B-B. Onda gigante que arrasta inimigos.
adv.am.wind_style_great_breakthrough.des: Rank C - combo: C-V-C. Rajada que arremessa o alvo longe.
adv.am.rasengan.title: Rasengan
adv.am.rasengan.desc: Rank A - combo: C-V-V. Esfera espiral de chakra (corpo a corpo).
adv.am.rasenshuriken.title: Rasenshuriken
adv.am.rasenshuriken.desc: Rank S - combo: C-V-B. Shuriken de vento, dano em area.
adv.am.earth_style_earth_spear.title: Doton: Doryuusou
adv.am.earth_style_earth_spear.desc: Rank C - combo: C-B-C. Estacas de terra saem do chao.
adv.am.earth_style_mud_wall.title: Doton: Doryuu Jouheki
adv.am.earth_style_mud_wall.desc: Rank C - combo: C-B-V. Parede de terra para defesa.
adv.am.chidori.title: Chidori
adv.am.chidori.desc: Rank A - combo: V-C-C. Mao de raio que perfura.
adv.am.lightning_blade.title: Raikiri
adv.am.lightning_blade.desc: Rank A - combo: V-C-V. Corte de raio (forma aperfeicoada).
adv.am.kirin.title: Kirin
adv.am.kirin.desc: Rank S - combo: V-C-B. Raio desce do ceu numa area.
adv.am.wood_style_nativity.title: Mokuton: Jukai Koutan
adv.am.wood_style_nativity.desc: Rank A - combo: V-V-C. Faz a floresta brotar.
adv.am.ice_style_demonic_ice_mirrors.des: Rank A - combo: V-V-B. Prisao de espelhos de gelo.
adv.am.rinnegan_almighty_push.title: Shinra Tensei
adv.am.rinnegan_almighty_push.desc: Rank S - combo: V-B-C. Empurra tudo ao redor.
adv.am.rinnegan_almighty_pull.title: Bansho Ten'in
adv.am.rinnegan_almighty_pull.desc: Rank S - combo: V-B-V. Atrai um alvo ate voce.
adv.am.kamui.title: Kamui
adv.am.kamui.desc: Rank S - combo: V-B-B. Teletransporte dimensional.
adv.am.sage_mode.title: Sennin Mode
adv.am.sage_mode.desc: Rank S - combo: B-C-C. Modo Sabio: atributos e sensing.
adv.am.tailed_beast_chakra_mode.title: Bijuu Chakra Mode
adv.am.tailed_beast_chakra_mode.desc: Rank S - combo: B-C-V. Manto de chakra da bijuu.
adv.am.curse_mark_stage_2.title: Marca Amaldicoada Niv.2
adv.am.curse_mark_stage_2.desc: Rank A - combo: B-C-B. Transformacao Juugo.
adv.am.byakugan.title: Byakugan
adv.am.byakugan.desc: Rank A - combo: B-V-C. Visao 360 e deteccao de chakra.
adv.am.sharingan.title: Sharingan
adv.am.sharingan.desc: Rank B - combo: B-V-V. Copia movimentos e preve ataques.
adv.am.eight_inner_gates.title: Hachimon Tonkou
adv.am.eight_inner_gates.desc: Rank S - combo: B-V-B. Oito Portoes: poder bruto.
adv.am.healing_jutsu.title: Iryo: Shosen Jutsu
adv.am.healing_jutsu.desc: Rank C - combo: B-B-C. Cura a si mesmo e aliados.
adv.am.creation_rebirth.title: Souzou Saisei
adv.am.creation_rebirth.desc: Rank S - combo: B-B-V. Regeneracao total temporaria.
adv.am.edo_tensei.title: Edo Tensei
adv.am.edo_tensei.desc: Rank S - combo: B-B-B. Reanima ninjas para lutar.
